name: Beccc
bio: Beccc is the Head of Staff (HoS) of Silver Springs Survival, otherwise known as Becc. As the HoS, she works with Mr_Simba on new and upcoming features for the server, as well as making sure the staff are able to do their job as intended.
history: Becc became a Moderator on the 5th of July 2015, then became an Admin on the 18th of March 2016. On January 29, 2019, Becc was promoted to the rank of HoS.
